references.title: Glossary — PM AGILE LSS
references.markdown:
# Glossary — PM AGILE LSS

Track: `PM_AGILE_LSS`

## WIP limit
Maximum work-in-progress allowed on a board column.

## definition of done
Checklist that must be true before an item is complete.

## SIPOC
Suppliers, Inputs, Process, Outputs, Customers map.

## control chart
Plot of a process metric with control limits.

## risk register
List of risks with owners and mitigations.

## stakeholder RACI
Responsible/Accountable/Consulted/Informed matrix.

## HITL gate
Human decision point in a workflow (e.g., go/no-go).

## retrospective
Team meeting to improve process based on evidence.

references.title: Process Improvement + Project Management — Device Lab Flow
references.markdown:
# Process Improvement + Project Management — Device Lab Flow

## Who this is for
Charter, RACI, WBS/schedule, sprint, risk, SIPOC, Pareto/root-cause, control chart, DMAIC case, change control/status/AI critique. Aligns to ASQ CSSGB BoK themes, PMI CAPM ECO, and PMI PMP 2026 ECO (People/Process/Business Environment with AI/sustainability/value in context). NOT a PMI ATP. No fake certs. No fabricated community outcomes.

## Tracks and academy
- Tracks: PM_AGILE_LSS
- Academy: ACADEMY_PROCESS_PM

## Duration
Ten Process/PM weeks on one Device Lab wait problem. Chart math weeks are calculator OK / generative-fill NO_AI. Sponsor demos use fixture counts only.

## Weekly map
- Week 01: Charter the noon checkout wait problem
- Week 02: RACI for the improvement team
- Week 03: WBS and schedule — critical path
- Week 04: Sprint board under capacity
- Week 05: Risk register with scores
- Week 06: SIPOC and process map
- Week 07: Pareto and root cause
- Week 08: Control chart on wait times
- Week 09: DMAIC case with real artifacts
- Week 10: Change control, status, AI-plan critique, capstone

## Assessments
Process Studio assessment mix: weekly PM/LSS quizzes, mid (20 original) on charter/RACI/WBS/sprint/risk/SIPOC, final (24 original) on Pareto/SPC/DMAIC/change/PMP-2026-context judgment, practical over ten artifact labs, and an end-to-end improvement simulation. Not a PMI ATP. No fabricated community outcomes.

## Claim boundary
Aligns to ASQ CSSGB BoK themes, PMI CAPM ECO, and PMI PMP 2026 ECO (People/Process/Business Environment; AI/sustainability/value in context). WAIKE is NOT a PMI ATP and grants no PMI/ASQ credential. Instructor keys stay out of the learner packet.

## Kinesthetic hook
Charter a real wait problem, run DMAIC on fixture data, and critique an AI plan without inventing outcomes.
